State as of 2026-11-18 11:28 (revived after the 16 Nov reboot; far-jackal is prime again).
- My community: COPILOT EXTENSION / REGISTRATION FIX. Lanes one at a time: (1) F196 pane takeover, coder pij-cultural-falcon (OMP, github-copilot/claude-opus-5.5-1m, holds coder/, parent far-jackal), scope at the prime's scratchpad firefly-f196-scope.md (auto supersede of a confirmed-dead pane holder in the daemon; unknown refuses with adopt --take-over; the banner prints the command); then (2) F195 liveness vs a lapsed native lease, (3) F197 omp -p child registering on its parent's pane, (4) the revive/close set F190, F193, F194 (one plan is fine).
- Staffing: builders are OMP seats on github-copilot/claude-opus-5.5-1m; reviewer and security are Copilot gpt-6.1-sol seats (spawn with --role worker), two rounds max (C34). No performance seat unless cost changes. Builds only through just shared-build, and Jordan's 11 Nov ruling holds: one build per PR, CI is the build, reviewers never build.
- Close seats between lanes: memory note, pij close, tmux kill-pane, then /bin/ps to confirm the process is gone (close only tombstones, F189).
- Report to the prime only at each lane FINAL; normal sends only for hand-offs and verdicts. The prime merges and bounces.
- Off-limits: workstream 004 (Copilot cache proxy), pm-004 silkworm, with pij-amazing-takin holding model-cost. Takin's pane %135 is F196's live proof.
- LOG.md entries from 16 to 18 Nov are the prime's (F190 to F197, #232 to #234). Next free F is after F197; check the LOG tail.
